title: Sasanian silver drachm of Shapur I
language_note: Museum catalogue record in English. Coin legends are in Pahlavi script but the BM record does not transcribe them; flagged for follow-up during ingestion if legend transliteration is needed.
original_text_excerpt: Bust of Shapur I right, wearing crenellated crown with earflap and diadem, globe; tied beard, large ball of hair, moustache. Fire altar and two armed attendants leaning on long staff, looking away from altar, crenellated crowns.
original_text_note: British Museum catalogue description used as the artefact record; no reference translation applicable (numismatic object).
notes: Coinage of Shapur I is directly contemporary with the ŠKZ inscription (persia-01) and the Valerian campaign it narrates — useful for cross-referencing numismatic and epigraphic evidence in the graph phase.
